role: Development screen for model operation in its declared SNR domain; not a BLER holdout.
prior_result: Exact Sionna CDL-A at 30 dB produced conventional 20/20 and NeuralRx 0/20.
hypothesis: The public model is evaluated only at -4.0 to -3.0 dB; 30 dB may be out of distribution.
decision_rule: NeuralRx must decode at least one TB and its aggregate correct count must exceed conventional to justify a variable-payload frozen holdout. Otherwise stop and diagnose engine/tensor semantics.
claim_boundary: Fixed-payload development data cannot support a BLER or generalization claim.
